title: Renewable Diamonds
description: Adds Diamond Recipe, if you hate going into the caves
body:
In this datapack you can craft Diamonds. But dont worry, craft not that easy to make. To craft diamonds, you need 1 Cyan Dye, 1 Light Blue Dye, 1 Blue Dye, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Gold Ingot, 1 Copper Ingot and 3 Coal.
![(crafting image)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2fa7112247f9300bbb1a687eab7722bcc4b053a.png)
